Find a nearby location that sells hunting and fishing licences, tags and related products and services.

You can visit any one of these licence issuers to:

  • renew an Outdoors Card
  • buy a fishing licence
  • buy a small game licence
  • buy a wild turkey licence
  • buy a wolf/coyote tag
  • buy big game licence for deer, moose and black bear
  • buy non-resident export permits

Some locations also let you apply to the big game draws to hunt moose, antlerless deer and deer in a controlled area.
